verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's first-party docs describe conversing with the reviewer in the PR: follow-up questions, clarifications, challenging recommendations, and exploring alternatives. They also document a full set of @coderabbitai commands for reviews, pausing, resolving comments, and showing configuration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of in-thread conversational quality (the community mention is only a hedged 'supposedly').

support.subject: As a developer, I reply to the reviewer in the PR thread to ask questions, get explanations, or issue commands — and it answers in context

citations.quote: you can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations, or explore alternative approaches
Learn how to interact with CodeRabbit through conversations and get clarifications on its feedback
Pause, resume, ignore reviews, request manual reviews, resolve comments, request approval, and update pull request summaries using @coderabbitai commands.
Use @coderabbitai full review when you want a complete pass over the entire pull request.
Use the `@coderabbitai configuration` command on any PR to get the resolved configuration in YAML format.
